annotations.title: Whether a hospital is nonprofit, for financial assistance

description: Whether a hospital is nonprofit, for financial assistance. For requests like "is St. Luke's in Boise a nonprofit?" or "does this hospital have to offer charity care?". Returns how Medicare lists the hospital's ownership (nonprofit, government, for-profit), its city and main phone number, and what that means for financial assistance. Nonprofit hospitals must have a financial assistance policy.

city.description: City, to pick between hospitals with the same name.

name.description: Hospital name as on the bill, like St. Luke's Regional Medical Center.

state.description: US state name or two-letter code. Recommended, since many hospitals share names.
